title: 경로 B 분석·학습계획·impact

schema_change.rationale: review enqueue reuses the existing requests/events/outbox ledger; no new durable tables required

verification.ruff: 0 findings in WP16-owned paths under cyrano/configs/quality/ruff.toml
verification.formatter: ruff format --check clean on WP16-owned paths
verification.basedpyright: 0 errors; remaining warnings are the accepted Unknown-from-Mapping/sqlite3 baseline class shared with verified WP09/WP10/WP14 files
verification.dev_check: dev.py check exit 0 after docs regeneration
verification.quality_gate: 0 findings in WP16-owned paths; pre-existing baseline debt in other files unchanged

architecture.analysis: analyze_patterns clusters EpisodeRecords into Hypotheses; confidence never exceeds hypothesis; expected_red/environment/requirement_change/workflow_failure/regression/agent_failure/unknown cause classes kept distinct; unknown is not_an_improvement_target; protected clusters are manual_only; gate-skipping lessons blocked; meta_depth>0 refused; learning_enabled defaults off
architecture.workplan: compile_learning_plan validates ops (observe/analyze/propose/evaluate/report only), ref resolution, depth<=3, cycles, budget/deadline/resource caps, and GEN-01 skip flags; plans start pending_review; approve_plan requires an independent reviewer; run_step holds no ambient permission; request_stop halts exploration only
architecture.candidates: propose_candidate freezes a digest-bound immutable diff; validate_delta checks expected revision, scope containment, grounds, protected fields (eval_criteria -> EVAL_CRITERIA_TAMPER), and size; enqueue_review writes terminal event + outbox job in one transaction keyed by the candidate id and coalesces duplicates (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT returns the existing job; STALE_REVISION still propagates); run_review is foreground-first inside the fence, refuses author-review, dead-letters failures via fail_job, and never applies a stale-fenced result
architecture.impact: assess_impact routes through classify: protected_change->manual, scheduling_only->A only when input semantics are unchanged and policy IR validated, otherwise transition_changing->B; author claims on the candidate are evidence, never routing input; classifier!=author enforced
architecture.skill_evaluation: SkillLane.evaluate/refine never touch active bytes; refine binds the candidate to the live revision; apply is CAS on base_revision with REBASE_REQUIRED on drift and REVIEW_INDEPENDENCE on self-approval; consolidate refuses missing required exceptions and never destroys inputs; resume_learning reclaims one expired learning lease via the outbox fence
architecture.repository_fix: claim_outbox expiry now compares lease_until to wall-clock now, not the monotonic floor; previously a fresh lease was immediately stealable once the floor advanced past it

not_established: native_dcode_runtime_learning (learning path verified at API level only)
real_candidate_patch_application (candidate diffs are sealed artifacts; apply is revision-CAS bookkeeping, not source writes)
